interpretation: Measured DRAM traffic is lower in the fused sample. This supports removal of intermediate global-memory transfers in the selected tail; it does not establish an application-level benefit.

Fused median achieved active-warps percentage is 59.13%; registers/thread is 43 (48 allocated), and the reported register launch limit is 10 CTAs/SM. These are separate achieved/static metrics, not a causal performance proof.
Fused median long-scoreboard, short-scoreboard, and barrier stall metrics are 33.56%, 14.64%, and 34.19%. They identify waits to investigate, not independent percentages of application wall time.
